charm.absmod.equip: Equip in its Curios slot, or offhand without Curios.
guide.absmod.page.38: Paw workshop: hold a physical Meow Blade in your main hand and an amethyst shard offhand. Use a smithing table without sneaking to imprint one crystal. The blade keeps its durability.
guide.absmod.page.39: Workshop charms: Craft each charm with a paw crystal. Ring: gold nugget + rabbit foot. Ears: leather + golden carrot. Mittens: rabbit hide + iron. Slippers: pink wool + rabbit foot.
guide.absmod.page.40: Pendant: string + nautilus shell. Sash: leather + sugar. Mantle: pink wool + phantom membrane. Equip in matching Curios slots, or use one offhand if Curios is absent.
guide.absmod.page.41: Rose smithing: pink dye on the left, iron gear or original kitchenware in the middle, paw crystal on the right. Upgrade the stove, board, pot, skillet, wooden or bamboo basket, oak cabinet, or iron knife. Light the stove with flint and steel.
advancement.absmod.paw_crystal.title: First Paw Imprint
advancement.absmod.paw_crystal.descripti: Paw workshop: hold a physical Meow Blade in your main hand and an amethyst shard offhand. Use a smithing table without sneaking to imprint one crystal. The blade keeps its durability.
advancement.absmod.rose_charms.title: Feline Curios
advancement.absmod.rose_charms.descripti: Craft any charm with a paw crystal and equip it for its effect.
advancement.absmod.rose_tools.title: Rose Toolkit
advancement.absmod.rose_tools.descriptio: Upgrade an iron tool at the smithing table.
advancement.absmod.rose_armor.title: Rose Guard
advancement.absmod.rose_armor.descriptio: Upgrade an iron armor piece at the smithing table.
advancement.absmod.rose_kitchen.title: Cherry Kitchen
advancement.absmod.rose_kitchen.descript: With Farmer’s Delight installed, upgrade one of its kitchen implements.
advancement.absmod.whisker_compass.title: Follow the Whiskers
advancement.absmod.whisker_compass.descr: Find your own cat or manifested spirit with the compass.
keepsake.absmod.whisker_compass: Charm slot. Sneak to trace the nearest companion within 24 blocks every four seconds.
guide.absmod.page.42: Stand at a cartography table. Use your own bound stage 2+ blade on it with an ordinary compass offhand. Wear the calibrated compass and sneak. Petals point toward your nearest tame cat or spirit within 24 blocks. Read the distance above your hotbar.
advancement.absmod.petal_anklet.title: Gather on Landing
advancement.absmod.petal_anklet.descript: Wear the anklet and collect a loose item by landing while sneaking.
keepsake.absmod.petal_anklet: Feet slot. Sneak upon landing from 2.5 blocks or more to gather visible drops within four blocks.
guide.absmod.page.43: Manifest your stage 3+ spirit. Finish any board game with a rabbit foot offhand, win or lose. Wear the anklet and sneak upon landing from at least 2.5 blocks. It gathers up to 12 eligible, visible item stacks within four blocks. Fall damage still applies.
advancement.absmod.rainfish_locket.title: Bottle the Rain
advancement.absmod.rainfish_locket.descr: Wear the locket and catch rain in a glass bottle under open sky.
keepsake.absmod.rainfish_locket: Necklace slot. In open rain, look up and use a glass bottle to catch water.
guide.absmod.page.44: While rain falls directly on your spirit, give her the first raw cod of the day with a glass bottle offhand. Wear the locket in open rain. Look up at least 45 degrees and use an empty bottle in your main hand to fill it with water.
keepsake.absmod.stage_required: Use your own bound physical blade of stage 2 or higher.
smithing.absmod.rose_gold.title: Rose Gold Upgrade
smithing.absmod.rose_gold.base: Add diamond gear or a Cookery utensil
guide.absmod.page.45: Mix 2 gold ingots, 4 copper ingots and 1 Paw Crystal in a crafting table for 2 rose gold ingots. Pack 9 into a block or unpack it. Repair rose gold equipment with ingots at an anvil.
guide.absmod.page.46: Craft a template with one diamond, copper block, Paw Crystal and pink dye. To copy: template at top centre, copper block in centre, gold ingots in the other seven slots. Each upgrade consumes a template and one alloy ingot.
guide.absmod.page.47: Smith a template, diamond tool and rose gold ingot, left to right. Choose a pick, axe, shovel, hoe or sword. Each has built-in Silk Touch I. Try glass. Fortune bases are rejected. Wear, names and compatible enchants carry over.
guide.absmod.page.48: Upgrade each diamond armor piece with the same template and ingot. Helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots retain diamond-level protection, gain durability and enchantability, and accept alloy ingots for repairs.
guide.absmod.page.49: With Kaleidoscope Cookery 1.6.0, smith a template, original utensil and rose gold ingot. Finish a stove, wok, stockpot, lid, steamer, spit, board, millstone, oil pot, enamel basin or spatula. Their original recipes and controls apply.
guide.absmod.page.50: The finish also covers racks, baskets, trays, teapots, cups, eight filled teas, clay-pot milk tea, four knives, the sickle, recipe, lunch bag and bin. Stored contents carry over. Obtain one finished utensil for the optional quest.
advancement.absmod.rose_alloy.title: Rose Gold Alloy
advancement.absmod.rose_gold_tools.title: A Silken Edge
advancement.absmod.rose_gold_tools.descr: Smith a tool with intrinsic Silk Touch.
advancement.absmod.rose_gold_armor.title: Rose Gold Armor
advancement.absmod.rose_gold_armor.descr: Upgrade a diamond armor piece with the template.
advancement.absmod.cookery_finish.title: Blush Cookery
advancement.absmod.cookery_finish.descri: Obtain a blush-finished Kaleidoscope Cookery utensil. Requires Cookery.
guide.absmod.page.51: Rose-patterned tools and armor boost each existing enchantment by one, including curses. Efficiency V works as VI; Protection IV works as V. Enchant the gear normally. Anvils and grindstones use its stored levels.
tooltip.absmod.rose_pattern: Rose pattern · existing enchantments gain one effective level
advancement.absmod.rose_pattern.title: Beyond the Bloom
advancement.absmod.rose_pattern.descript: Obtain an enchanted rose-patterned tool or piece of armor.
advancement.absmod.blossom_windows.title: Windows in Bloom
advancement.absmod.blossom_windows.descr: Obtain a pink glowing glass pane.
advancement.absmod.blossom_gallery.title: A Blush Gallery
advancement.absmod.blossom_gallery.descr: Obtain a pink clear display frame and try displaying your blade.
advancement.absmod.blossom_lighting.desc: Obtain both a cherry floor lamp and a table lamp.
advancement.absmod.cherry_tearoom.title: A Cherry Tea Room
advancement.absmod.cherry_tearoom.descri: Obtain a tea table, flower stand and storage cabinet.
guide.absmod.page.52: Craft four pink stained glass and one glowstone dust into four pink glowing glass. Two rows of three yield 16 panes. Both emit light level 12 and drop when broken. Panes join neighboring panes.
guide.absmod.page.53: Combine an item frame, one pink glowing pane and pink petals. Mount it on a wall, floor or ceiling. The open center shows the wall behind the item. Use to insert or rotate an exhibit. In survival, hit once for the item and again for the frame.
guide.absmod.page.54: Lay out paper, glowing glass and paper in one row. Center a cherry slab below for a table lamp. For a floor lamp, put a cherry fence below the glass and a slab below the fence. It needs solid ground and two blocks of space. Use either half with an empty hand to toggle it.
guide.absmod.page.55: Tea table: three cherry slabs above a cherry fence, pink petals and a cherry fence. Flower stand: slab, fence, slab in a column; put a flower pot on top. Cabinet: three cherry slabs across the top and bottom, with pink petals, a barrel and petals in the middle. It holds 27 stacks.
tea.absmod.selected: Spirit selected. Ring the bell on a filled coaster.
tea.absmod.select_first: First ring the bell on your manifested spirit nearby.
tea.absmod.busy: Already invited. Ring the bell on the spirit to cancel.
tea.absmod.empty: Put a milkshake on this coaster first.
tea.absmod.invited: Your spirit is coming to the table. Stay nearby.
tea.absmod.no_path: Leave a clear path to a supported square beside the table.
tea.absmod.served: Your spirit finished the milkshake and returned its bucket.
mirror.absmod.blade: Use the mirror with your own bound physical normal VIII blade.
mirror.absmod.qualified: This blade has won its trial. Take it to the workshop.
mirror.absmod.busy: Another trial occupies this area. Wait or move farther away.
mirror.absmod.space: Clear two blocks above the mirror.
mirror.absmod.started: Trial opened. Keep your blade in hand and watch the signals.
mirror.absmod.ended: Attempt ended. Return with the blade to retry.
mirror.absmod.slam: Slam · leave the marked purple circle
mirror.absmod.open: Opening · strike while the shards spread!
mirror.absmod.won: Trial won! Take this blade, 250 affection and 16 amethyst blocks to resonance.
cats.absmod.scratch_nearby: Select your cat with the bell and bring it beside the post awake.
cats.absmod.scratch: Your cat pats the scratching post and purrs.
cats.absmod.spirit_trial_locked: This blade still needs its own mirror victory
resonance.absmod.boss_locked: Win the Heart Mirror trial with this blade first.
guide.absmod.page.56:
Tea for Two

Use a tray on the top of a low cherry table. Place a milkshake, ring the bell on your spirit, then on that cup. Leave a clear square beside the table.
guide.absmod.page.57:
Serving a Cup

A finished drink returns one bucket and shares the daily talk reward. Ring the spirit again to cancel. Leaving, taking the cup or breaking the table interrupts. Guests can take cups.
guide.absmod.page.58:
Nest Diary

Bind a nest and leave a path within 16 blocks. Lying down records the place and world tick. Select your cat from the first row of its pedigree. Check its rest history in the bell.
guide.absmod.page.59:
A Cherry Corner

A cushion works as a nest: pink petals over pink wool, cherry slab, pink wool. For a post, center pink wool over string on three cherry slabs. Use the bell on the post beside your selected, awake cat.
guide.absmod.page.60:
Heart Mirror

Craft with an amethyst block above shard, pink glowing glass, shard, and crying obsidian below. Use your own bound normal VIII blade. Leave two blocks above; keep the blade drawn within 12 blocks.
guide.absmod.page.61:
Final Resonance

Dodge the white line and purple landing circle. Attack as the shards open. Retry freely. Victory belongs to that blade. At 250 affection, bring it and 16 amethyst blocks to resonance. Recover the blade under your world’s normal death rules.
guide.absmod.page.6:
Normal stages VII–IX

VII: 140 affection, 16 chorus fruits, 2 shulker shells, 4 diamonds.
VIII: 190 affection, 1 nether star and 1 heart of the sea.
IX: 250 affection, 16 amethyst blocks and a victory on this blade. See pp. 60–61.

advancement.absmod.set_tea_table.descrip: Fit a milkshake tray to the low cherry table.
advancement.absmod.spirit_tea.title: An Invitation to Tea
advancement.absmod.spirit_tea.descriptio: Invite your spirit and finish serving the selected cup.
advancement.absmod.cat_rest.title: Home for a Nap
advancement.absmod.cat_rest.description: Let your cat reach its bound nest and lie down.
advancement.absmod.mirror_trial.title: Enter the Mirror
advancement.absmod.mirror_trial.descript: Start the trial with your own bound normal VIII blade.
advancement.absmod.mirror_victory.title: Face Your Echo
advancement.absmod.mirror_victory.descri: Defeat the echo during its openings with the participating blade.
advancement.absmod.normal_stage_9.title: IX · One Soul
advancement.absmod.normal_stage_9.descri: Complete resonance on the normal blade that won its trial.
